description: Implementation of ue_drx_controller class managing Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in a 3GPP LTE/NR UE context, including timers and slot indication handling.

classes.name: ue_drx_controller
classes.description: Class managing DRX behavior, timers, and slot indications for a UE.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures DRX settings based on new configuration.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication events to update active time windows.

methods.name: is_pdcch_enabled
methods.description: Checks if PDCCH is enabled based on DRX configuration and active time.

methods.name: is_active_time
methods.description: Determines if the UE is in active time, considering timers and pending SR.

methods.name: update_inactivity_timer
methods.description: Updates inactivity timer based on PDCCH activity.

methods.name: on_new_dl_pdcch_alloc
methods.description: Handles new DL PDCCH allocation events.

methods.name: on_new_ul_pdcch_alloc
methods.description: Handles new UL PDCCH allocation events, including HARQ timers.

methods.name: on_dl_harq_nack
methods.description: Handles DL HARQ NACK events to update timers.

methods.name: on_con_res_start
methods.description: Starts contention resolution timer based on UL-CCCH slot.
